rows.en:
Nngh… What stubborn pests!

I can't leave it to the regenerated robots any longer! I'll face you myself! Prepare yourselves!
Whoa… What? This shaking? What's happening!?
Bwah…
What's wrong? Why did it stop? Why won't it regenerate anymooore!?
Waruder! Are you all right?

Ugh…

Do not worry about me! In all my life, I have never had a happier day than today…

Waruder… I knew.

That to remove my Agony Circuit, you gave me part of your own energy circuit…
What!? Then…
Waruder's life is…!?
Lady Bijinder…

Now that Shadow is gone… there's no one left to use the Agony Circuit.

Waruder… I'm giving you back your energy circuit.

Waruder…

You knew you had only a little life left, and still you fought alongside us?

What are you saying, Lord Zero-One… I merely did what was natural.

All of it… because we are comrades.
Waruder…

…!?

But where is Lady Bijinder…?

(…………

No one's here. It's so quiet. Shadow really is gone… After all, I feel so free.

I don't want to go back to days spent doing nothing but fighting… No one could understand. This feeling of mine…)
Defeat Waruder!
Defeat Shadow Knight and all Shadowmen!
Defeat all the Shadow robots and blow up the base of the Great World Crime Organization Shadow!
Officer Oka… Still no word from Kishida, who went to search for Go?
No, not yet…

Captain! Emergency transmission from Space Station V1!

They say they're under attack by an unidentified fleet of spaceships!

What!? V1 is…?

All right, we'll sortie at once! Officer Oka, put the Space Arrow on standby!

About that…

The entire base has been covered by a powerful electromagnetic field…

The space rocket port is paralyzed too! The receivers seem to be working, but the transmitters are out of action…
Then… it's as good as having our arms and legs torn off, isn't it!? Isn't there some way to fly?
Gate 1 won't open either! At this rate, there's nothing we can…
It seems you're in some trouble, gentlemen?
Who on earth are you!?
We are the Alien Nackle… Soon the Earth will be ours!
What!? Don't talk nonsense!
It seems you don't believe me…
You bastard! As long as we, MAT, are here, we won't let you do as you please!
Heh heh heh…
What's so funny?
When you always rely on Ultraman's power…
Wh-what…!?

Your guardian deity… Ultraman will never appear again! He lost to Black King!

Now… there is nothing at all for us to fear!
So you're the ones who stole the Saturn Z, too!?

We… do not like to see the Earth prosper in peace.

We intend to use the Saturn Z on you!

Attention, MAT… Surrender unconditionally within twelve hours!

Otherwise… we will fire the Saturn Z at your MAT!
Do you think MAT would fall for a threat like that!?
Then… let me show you something interesting…

…!?

Space Station V1… That's an incredible number of spaceships, though. What on earth are they planning?

…………

V1 has been destroyed…
Damn it… Then it's a battle to avenge them!
That fleet of spaceships is heading for Earth! Captain…!
We have something else to do!

The Alien Nackle must have a base somewhere around Tokyo…

When the twelve hours are up, they intend to welcome in that fleet! Before then, we'll trace the electromagnetic waves back and pinpoint their secret base!
You mean to take back the Saturn Z?
Minami, Ueno!

We'll trace the electromagnetic waves back and pinpoint the secret base!

Watch out for Black King! Sortie at once!

Damn… So the Kelbaan have come to greet us?

Kishida!?

What about Go? Did you find Go?
No, it's no good. I couldn't find the MAT Vehicle either.
Then what about Go?
I'm sorry, but…
Damn it! Alien Nackle, I won't forgive you!
So you've shown up, Black King! Uoooooh!

Soon the Earth will be ours… Hahaha…

Now… hurry and tear Ultraman limb from limb! Rip him to pieces!
"The only way to revive Ultraman is 'Operation Ultra Star'! Seven, I need your help!"
"Understood… Let's make the Ultra Star."
"There! He's hanging from the Alien Nackle's spaceship!"
"First, let's destroy that spaceship!"
Heaaah!
Jowaaah!
"Good… Now we make the Ultra Star with our energy!"
"It's no good… We don't have enough energy!?"
"Don't give up, Ultraseven! Let the light of the Ultra Star shine on this land!"

An undersea explosion in Tokyo Bay…!?

Captain! The base… MAT's base is…
So now… we don't even have a place to go back to.
Captain! The MAT Arrows are almost out of fuel too.
Damn… MAT's base, destroyed by the Saturn Z that MAT built…
How long will our fuel last?
About ten minutes, at most.
It's about the same here.

Captain! Ten minutes is plenty, isn't it!?

We at MAT don't need anything like ten minutes to beat a kaiju!
All right, don't stand around! Let's go!

With this, MAT is wiped out too!

And our fleet of spaceships will arrive on Earth very soon!

The Earth belongs to us, the Alien Nackle! Hahahaha…!
"Not so fast, Alien Nackle! I've destroyed your fleet of spaceships!"
What!? Who are you?
It's Ultraman! Ultraman is alive!

U12620: 降汰 read as 降伏 "surrender". "on you" for お前たちのために (ironic "for your sake").
U12628/U12631: 近迅 read as 近辺, 辿え as 迎え, 逆深知 as 逆探知 "trace back".
U12632: お出辿え read as お出迎え "come to greet us".
U12635: 残怠 read as 残念; Kishida implies Go may be dead.
U12639-U12647/U12658: 『』 telepathic dialogue (Ultras / unseen Ultraman) rendered in "double quotes"; ［ウルトラの星作戦］ as 'Operation Ultra Star'.
omissions_kept: U12654: "It's about the same here" - Kishida's fuel.
